description: Delete a Proton Photos album. The server asks the user to approve this itself. Refuses an album that still contains photos unless force=true. Never deletes your own photos; they stay in the timeline. save maps to the CLI's undocumented --save option (no observable difference for your own photos) — leave it off unless asked. Show the user the album name and photo count first.

confirmed.description: Optional and ignored: the server asks the user to approve this itself. You do not need to send it.

force.description: If true, delete even if the album still contains photos. Default false.

save.description: CLI --save option (undocumented, no observable effect). Default false.

name: photos_delete_album
title: Delete photo album
